summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi LRCX 2x Daily ETF (LRCC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Lam Research Corporation (NASDAQ: LRCX), through derivatives such as swaps. LRCC was launched on Jul 7, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
